correctness.rationale: Read the complete pinned RESULT.md, verify.py, exact source tree and package metadata. Monomial orthogonality and independent gamma(|alpha_i|+1,1) radial powers give block beta(k+ell,m-k+d-ell) tail = Bin(m+d-1,tau) CDF at k+ell-1. Block weak compositions reproduce w_{m,k} and sum to dim H_m. Reconstructed uniform left-tail method-of-types sandwich exp[-NI]/(N+1)<=CDF<=exp[-NI] for j/N<=tau, CDF>=1/(N+1) otherwise; changing j/N to k/m costs O(log m) uniformly by endpoint entropy continuity. Uniform binomial polynomial multiplicity expansion and bounded-variation Riemann sum give m^d integral with claimed O(m^(d-1)log m), not a finite extrapolation. Independent exact beta/binomial checks 1,215 index cases and symbolic d=3,ell=2,tau=1/2 integral log2/6-5/48 agree. m=0 handled separately by exact eigenvalues; n,m growing only at fixed d,ell,tau.
